identity.statement: One-line positioning statement under the owner's name. Must fit two lines at a 360px phone width (~70 Latin characters). 'North of England' is the region the owner lives in.
manifest.departures: Decorative header of a split-flap airport DEPARTURES board styled as the site index. One short word, shown uppercase.
manifest.nowBoarding: Airport-board status shown on the row for the page the visitor is currently on. Very short (≈12 characters).
manifest.onTime: Airport-board status shown on every other row. Very short (≈8 characters).
githubCta.commits: Commit count of this site's repository. {formatted} is the already-formatted number; keep the <num></num> tag around it.
githubCta.pushed: {when} is a short relative time such as '5m ago' or '3 Oct', already localised.
location.timeLabel: Accessible name of the owner's live local-time plate. {time} like '1:01', {period} the AM/PM word (only in the 'yes' branch), {town} a place name (not translated).
location.live: Badge shown when the location fix is fresh. Very short, uppercase.
sound.label: Label beside the footer's speaker button; followed by On/Off. Shown uppercase.
sound.hoverLines: Instruction to hover the giant name at the bottom of the page, whose letters are 'guitar strings' that play notes.
copyright.withYear: {year} is the current year, {name} the owner's name, already in the reader's script.
terminal.path: Working-directory label in the title bar of a small mock terminal window. Keep the '~/' prefix; translate the folder name ('elsewhere' = the owner's profiles on other sites) as ONE lowercase word or hyphenated words with no spaces, as a real folder name would be. Very short.
terminal.cmd.github: A command typed into a mock terminal that opens the owner's GitHub profile. Write it as a short lowercase terminal-style command in the target language: translate the verb 'open' (imperative), keep the product name 'github' in lowercase Latin letters exactly. No trailing punctuation. Under ~20 characters.
terminal.cmd.linkedin: A command typed into a mock terminal that opens the owner's LinkedIn profile. Write it as a short lowercase terminal-style command in the target language: translate the verb 'open' (imperative), keep the product name 'linkedin' in lowercase Latin letters exactly. No trailing punctuation. Under ~20 characters.
terminal.cmd.resume: A command typed into a mock terminal that opens the owner's CV/résumé page. Write it as a short lowercase terminal-style command in the target language: translate the verb 'open' (imperative), keep the word for résumé/CV short and lowercase. No trailing punctuation. Under ~20 characters.
elsewhere.linkLabel: Accessible name of a link in the footer terminal. {command} is the typed command and {handle} the address, both VISIBLE on screen, so they must stay FIRST and in this order: screen-reader and voice-control users speak what they see (WCAG 2.5.3). Only the punctuation between them and {description} may follow your language.
